title: how much margin must a donor clear before the flip is worth acting on?
verdict_reason: a buffer alone peaks at precision 0.154 (tp 2 of 13 flagged) at b=0.0443, against 0.143 unbuffered; the closest non-move clears its threshold by 0.0443 while the closest move clears it by 0.0455, so no b keeps that move and drops that non-move; a non-move clears by up to 245.95% of its threshold, so the buffer that would clear every one of them costs every move; the own-side guard reaches 2/2 with no buffer at all
